text: Call of Duty Mobile is not just a game for me, it has become a habit. I have been playing it for the past 3–4 years, and honestly, I haven’t faced any major problems so far. The game runs very smoothly, whether you play long sessions or intense matches. Issues like lag or crashes are very rare. The gameplay is highly engaging, the controls are responsive, and with every update, new content keeps the game fresh and interesting. Both Multiplayer and Battle Royale having solid experience.

CODM is an amazing game with great graphics and smooth gameplay. I have one strong suggestion — please consider adding a Sea Battle Royale mode. A map focused on ocean combat with ships, boats, submarines, and small islands would be something completely new and exciting. Players could fight on moving ships, capture naval bases, and even have limited underwater combat. Adding dynamic weather like storms and big waves would make matches more intense and realistic.

Call of Duty Mobile is an amazing game, but I have one suggestion: please add an AI Bot Mode for casual players. Sometimes normal gamers just want to relax and enjoy matches without facing ranked players or highly skilled/pro gamers. A fun AI mode with different difficulty levels (Easy, Medium, Hard) will help beginners practice, improve skills, and enjoy the game without pressure. This feature can make COD Mobile even more enjoyable for everyone.

I have many great memories with Call of Duty: Mobile. I played this game from 2019 to 2025, and most of my best memories were made during the COVID-19 lockdown. During that time, I spent hours playing Battle Royale with my brother. We mainly played Duo matches on Isolated,and Squad matches on Alcatraz. Those gaming sessions were some of the most enjoyable moments of that period. The game offers exciting gameplay and good graphics. Although I have stopped playing due to my busy routine.

In between high intense games, it throws me out of the game and I lose valuable points. Every day it's happening. It shows unable to connect or server error. Now it's a daily routine and I feel frustrated. Again I have to start, reconnect and then I enter in the middle of the game. Either I lose the game or lose points but losing something is confirmed. Irritating.....

I would give this a 5-star because I just love the details and the whole soundtrack. Apart from that, there's the Free Legendary and Mythic skins. There's no problem about hackers. The players are really supportive. Sometimes, I experience the internet ping problem (like me just moving and the other players freezing momentarily) despite having a good internet connection. But, honestly, when I just downloaded the game, I was feeling like, it would once impress me. Definitely worth trying. 😇

it's not a military based game it was 2-3 years back, and there is a massive issue to download literally everything in game now, atleast we had some gun skins pre installed like the rus and m4 but not even those guns are pre installed anymore, events are a pointless clutter, and the battlepass are a total let down each season. Thank you Cod for the precious memories you gave countless players, but it just doesn't feel the same anymore.

Your updates are making this game more and more unplayable on my device and any mid ranged device. The low graphics were fine before 2 or 3 updates but now they have rendering problems. The game is laggy too. The new update also created an audio bug. I love the game, and would love to keep playing it but it's just not playable anymore. Stop thinking about events and skins and start with fixing the game. The game was okay last year, but now it has a load of problems.

I am playing this game since 2 yrs and I have no words to explain the satisfaction that this game gave me.. I have played delta force, free fire, bgmi and other games but this one hits different.. it's lowest graphics are better than the highest graphics of many games.. it's has regular events also there are plenty of guns, achievements, camos, mastery and many more things to achieve. But the matchmaking needs to be fixed because it has sum glitches . I dont understand why people play free fire.

I've always loved this game and admired how such an amazing experience was possible on mobile. I even recommended it to my brothers and friends. But lately: frequent frame drops at 90 FPS (my device supports 120 FPS), random MP stutters, game freezing while reviving teammates in Resurgence, ADS scope bug after getting knocked, and sensitivity feels different without changing settings. Please fix these issues.🥺

Call of Duty: Mobile is honestly one of the best mobile games ever made. The graphics are incredible, the controls are smooth, and the gameplay feels very realistic and exciting. I love the different modes like Battle Royale and Multiplayer, and the regular updates always bring fresh content, skins, maps, and events. The game runs great and gives a real console-like experience on mobile. Playing with friends makes it even more fun and competitive. this game deserves 5 star 🌟

Call of Duty: Mobile is one of the most popular mobile games, but it also has several negative aspects that many players complain about. One major issue is how addictive the game can become. Many students and teenagers spend hours playing every day, which can affect studies, sleep, and even health. Instead of focusing on homework, outdoor games, or spending time with family, some players become too attached to the game and waste valuable time. Another problem is the toxic environment in matches.

Call Of Duty Mobile bringing familiar gameplay to mobile devices. The controls take some getting used to, but the game runs smoothly and the graphics are impressive. The multiplayer mode is fast-paced and fun, with a good selection of maps and modes. However, the game can feel a bit repetitive and the microtransactions can be aggressive. Overall, it's a good option for fans of first-person shooters and CoD enthusiasts, but may not offer anything new for a more innovative experience.

Really fun, Great combination of most Call of Duty games. Though, I recommend making it easier to gain Battle Pass tiers. The challenges don't really grant enough BP XP. Also, maybe add custom rules for games against bots, so we can make our own mini game. I also think that you should be able to use any attachment you want when you are playing against the Al, so that way you know if you want to put in the time to unlock it. Thanks!

As someone who's played a whole lot of FPS Android shooters, this is the closest experience you can get compared to playing on PC.

I have been playing COD for almost a decade, since Modern Warfare. If you are a veteran player, you'll find a lot to love here. Matches connect and load in under 10 seconds. Graphics are ALMOST on par with the Xbox 360 versions of COD. Controls (after you heavily adjust them) are perfect. Really, this surprised me the most. It's incredible how well they have translated the controls of COD/MOD into a mobile format. Sound is spot on, gave me some decent nostalgia feels. Play with headphones, far easier to hear an opponent coming your way. On the graphics - the devs have made it super easy to spot an enemy player, so after a few rounds of practice, you'll be fragging like a pro. The only negative is possible the microtransactions, but who the F cares? Just ignore it - you level up quickly and the game throws new upgrades at you. There is battle royale, ranked and casual multiplayer currently. Can't wait to see what else COD Mobile has for me. Just download it!!!
